name: Arga Labs

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 10 pre-built digital twins/month; 1 twin per run; fixed 10-minute run sessions; community support. Docs describe the same tier as 10 URL Test Runs/month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Flat $1,250/month (not a usage credit). 1,500 twin runs/month, 30,000 long-running twin minutes/month, 1,500 CI checks/month (separate, non-fungible buckets); unlimited app twins; long-running scenarios, test runner, saved tests; community support. Overage terms not published.

plans.name: Team
plans.note: From $3,500/month, adjusted by usage & team size; unlimited twins, twin runs, long-running twin minutes and CI checks; SOC 2 compliance (listed); onboarding + priority support; Twin Run TTL up to 480 min.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom pricing; permanent scenarios; scoped team roles & access; custom infra changes; on-prem hosting if requested; SSO/access controls; auditability; dedicated forward deployed engineer.

caveats: Free 10 twins/mo and 10min runs; Pro $1250/mo with 1500 runs, 30k long-running twin minutes, 1500 CI checks; Team from $3500 quote-adjusted, Enterprise custom/on-prem. Not a raw 4/8 sandbox rate; stateful API twins have different units.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Docs plans page (Free/Team/Paid: Team 500 PR Test Runs + 500 CI checks) disagrees with the pricing page (Free/Pro/Team/Enterprise: Pro 1,500 twin runs + 1,500 CI checks). Pricing page used as the authority.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

fleet.verification: Self-serve Free and Pro via app checkout (Settings > Upgrade subscription); Team/Enterprise via demo call.
fleet.tiers: Free: 1 twin per run, 10 twins/month, 10-min TTL. Pro: 1,500 twin runs + 30,000 long-running twin minutes + 1,500 CI checks per month. Team (from $3,500) and Enterprise: unlimited.
fleet.notes: Card has no fleet block. No concurrency limit is published for Twin Runs; limits are monthly run/minute counts. Twins are API replicas, not VMs.
